overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference); merged into one overload with a union-typed object param. Also replaced the mechanical one-line-per-doc-line parsing of the repeating '...(colNum;order)' pair with a proper VariadicGroup, since it's a repeatable (colNum,order) tuple for multi-level sorts, not fixed positional params.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box.

members.name: colNum
members.description: Column number whose array values are used as a sort criterion. Any array data type is accepted except pictures and pointers.

members.name: order
members.description: Sort order for this column: '>' for ascending, '<' for descending.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Applies a standard (possibly multi-level) sort to the rows of the designated list box, using one or more (column, order) pairs as sort criteria; sort level is defined by pair position in the call.

constraints: Columns are synchronized: sorting is automatically applied to all columns of the list box, not just the one(s) used as criteria.
Does not take the list box's Sortable property into account.
